source: the stylesheet bodies read during a live signed-out load of /music/genres/pop/ on epidemicsound.com (linked CSS bundles from network responses plus inline <style> blocks, re-parsed with CSSStyleSheet); resolved in a probe carrying the real sheets with each theme class on <body> plus the radii-override class every shipped page carries (dark = radii-override alone, light-theme-override, alternative-theme-override, alternative-light-theme-override), at 1440 x 900. The plugin-theme-override and premiere-pro-theme-override sets serve the Adobe plugin embeds and were not resolved

properties.--mask-corner: radial-gradient(circle var(--mask-r) at var(--mask-r) var(--mask-r),#000 calc(100% - .25px),#0000 calc(100% + .25px))
